title: Laashe abbas par
body:
laashe abbas par sheh jo aaye
haye haye
dekha bhai ko khoon mein nahaye
<<DIVIDER>>
lipte bhai ke laashe se sarwar
aur bole
kaise sadme falak ne dikhaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
choor zakhmon se saara badan hai
haye kaise
bhai ka bhai laasha uthaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
dasht e ghurbat mein bhai ko bhai
mere bhai
chod kar is tarha se na jaaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke boli sakina ke hae hae
mere ammu
aap aise gaye phir na aaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi shaam e ghariban to zainab
ro ke boli
kaun hai ab jo aa kar bachaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli zainab madad kar madad kar
sher mere
meri chadar kahin chin na jaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhe sheron se bhai ka laasha
ay khudaya
waqt behno pe aisa na aaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
maange ro kar shah e deen ki dukhtar
kooze laa kar
shimr pani zameen par bahaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
kar rahe hai jafayein sitamgar
ay dilawar
sheh ki beti kahin mar na jaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai sakina ke rukhsaar neele
haye itne
zaalimon ne tamache lagaye
haye haye
laashe abbas par...
